<script setup lang="ts">
import type { CollapsibleRootEmits, CollapsibleRootProps } from '@vase-ui/vue/collapsible'
import { Collapsible } from '@vase-ui/vue/collapsible'

interface Props extends /* @vue-ignore */ CollapsibleRootProps {}
interface Emits extends /* @vue-ignore */ CollapsibleRootEmits {}

defineProps<Props>()
defineEmits<Emits>()
</script>

<template>
  <Collapsible.Root v-slot="slotProps" data-slot="collapsible">
    <slot v-bind="slotProps" />
  </Collapsible.Root>
</template>

<script setup lang="ts">
import type { CollapsiblePanelProps } from '@vase-ui/vue/collapsible'
import { Collapsible } from '@vase-ui/vue/collapsible'

interface Props extends /* @vue-ignore */ CollapsiblePanelProps {}

defineOptions({
  inheritAttrs: false,
})

defineProps<Props>()
</script>

<template>
  <Transition
    enter-active-class="overflow-hidden transition-[height] duration-200 ease-out"
    leave-active-class="overflow-hidden transition-[height] duration-200 ease-out"
    enter-from-class="h-0"
    enter-to-class="h-(--collapsible-panel-height)"
    leave-from-class="h-(--collapsible-panel-height)"
    leave-to-class="h-0"
  >
    <Collapsible.Panel data-slot="collapsible-content" v-bind="$attrs">
      <slot />
    </Collapsible.Panel>
  </Transition>
</template>

<script setup lang="ts">
import type { CollapsibleTriggerProps } from '@vase-ui/vue/collapsible'
import { Collapsible } from '@vase-ui/vue/collapsible'
import { computed, useTemplateRef } from 'vue'

interface Props extends /* @vue-ignore */ CollapsibleTriggerProps {}

defineProps<Props>()

const part = useTemplateRef<{ element: Element | null }>('part')
// An outer trigger that renders this wrapper in its element slot reads the element of the part.
defineExpose({ element: computed(() => part.value?.element ?? null) })
</script>

<template>
  <Collapsible.Trigger ref="part" data-slot="collapsible-trigger">
    <template v-if="$slots.element" #element="slotProps">
      <slot name="element" v-bind="slotProps" />
    </template>
    <slot />
  </Collapsible.Trigger>
</template>

export { default as Collapsible } from './Collapsible.vue'
export { default as CollapsibleContent } from './CollapsibleContent.vue'
export { default as CollapsibleTrigger } from './CollapsibleTrigger.vue'
